phase_0.boundary_condition: The Earth's atmosphere acts as the terminal detector volume that contains the full cascade development from first interaction to ground-level footprint, closing the cosmic propagation path.

⊢.justification: The state before the primary proton is emitted from its astrophysical accelerator — no particle, no trajectory, no information encoded.

⊣.justification: The atmosphere forms the closed boundary that captures the entire air shower development, fixing the cascade geometry and energy deposit as a complete measurement record.

≻.justification: The forward morphism of the proton traveling from source to Earth, accumulating path information and redshift evolution along its null geodesic.

≺.justification: The reverse morphism where ground-based detectors invert the cascade development to reconstruct the primary energy, direction, and mass — a descent from measured secondaries to inferred primary.

⋈.justification: Sequential composition of interaction lengths: each nuclear collision chains to the next, building the longitudinal shower profile step by step.

⊙.justification: The proton's extreme Lorentz factor (γ ~ 10^11) makes its rest-frame identity recognizable in any frame — the particle knows itself through its invariant mass and charge.

∈.justification: At the GZK cutoff energy (~5×10^19 eV), the proton's fate splits: the T-arm survives to Earth without catastrophic photopion loss; the F-arm undergoes Δ+ resonance with CMB photons and loses energy before arrival.

∋.justification: The measured cosmic-ray spectrum reunites both arms: the suppressed flux below cutoff (F-arm) and the rare super-GZK events (T-arm) like the OMG particle, forming the complete observed distribution.

⊤.justification: The affirmative arm: the proton exceeds the GZK threshold by five orders of magnitude, affirming its origin from a nearby or exceptionally powerful source that evades standard attenuation.

⊥.justification: The negative arm: typical UHE protons interact with CMB photons via p + γ_CMB → Δ+ → p + π^0 / n + π^+, losing ~20% energy per interaction, refuting their survival to Earth at super-GZK energies.

⊞.justification: The OMG particle holds both states simultaneously: it is attenuated (should not exist) yet detected (does exist) — a live contradiction that encodes new physics (nearby source, new particle, or Lorentz violation) without resolution.

⊡.justification: The 1991 Fly's Eye detection permanently fixes the event: 3.2×10^20 eV, direction, shower profile — an append-only ROM record that cannot be undone, anchoring the cosmic error-correction in empirical fact.

phase_2.failure_reason: Tri-ancestral reconnection over a transformed object — closes

phase_3.void_description: No primary particle exists; the accelerator has not yet emitted; the detector waits in darkness.
phase_3.true_description: A super-GZK proton survives propagation, reaches Earth, and generates a measurable air shower encoding its origin vector.
phase_3.false_description: The proton interacts with CMB photons, loses energy via photopion production, and falls below detection threshold before reaching the atmosphere.
phase_3.both_description: The OMG particle event: a detected super-GZK proton that should not exist under standard propagation — the measurement holds both the affirmation of its detection and the refutation of its possibility, creating a live error-correction signal pointing to new physics.

steps.domain_action: Genesis — the pre-launch void before the primary proton is emitted from its astrophysical source (active galactic nucleus, gamma-ray burst, or unknown accelerator).
The proton self-identifies via its invariant rest mass (938 MeV) and charge (+1), establishing its Lorentz-invariant identity across all frames.
Intergalactic propagation begins — the proton travels along a null geodesic, redshifting, traversing magnetic fields, accumulating path information in its phase.
At the GZK threshold energy (~5×10^19 eV), the propagation forks: T-arm = survival without catastrophic interaction; F-arm = photopion energy loss via Δ+ resonance with CMB photons.
On the T-arm, the proton exceeds the cutoff by five orders of magnitude (3.2×10^20 eV), affirming a propagation path that evades standard attenuation — nearby source, heavy nucleus, or new physics.
On the F-arm, standard protons undergo p + γ_CMB → Δ+ → p + π^0, losing ~20% energy per interaction, refuting their survival to Earth at super-GZK energies.
The OMG particle event holds both arms simultaneously — detected (T) yet forbidden (F) — a live B-state paradox that encodes the error-correction signal: the universe corrects our propagation model.
Nested fork — the atmospheric interaction vertex splits: T-arm = hadronic cascade development; F-arm = electromagnetic sub-shower from π^0 decay.
On the hadronic T-arm, the cascade develops through sequential nuclear interactions (p + N → π^±, π^0), building the muonic and hadronic components.
On the electromagnetic F-arm, π^0 → γγ initiates pair production and bremsstrahlung, creating the dominant electron-photon cascade.
The hadronic and electromagnetic arms rejoin at shower maximum (X_max ~ 800 g/cm^2), forming the complete longitudinal profile with both components.
Reconstruction backpropagation begins — ground detectors (Fly's Eye) measure Cherenkov/fluorescence light and invert the cascade to infer primary energy, direction, and mass.

Cascade stage chaining — each nuclear interaction length (λ_int ~ 90 g/cm^2 in air) composes sequentially: first interaction → p + N → π^±, π^0 → μ^±, e^±, γ → further generations, building the longitudinal profile.
At shower maximum, the cascade self-recognizes its critical size — the number of particles peaks, the longitudinal profile encodes the primary energy via the Gaisser-Hillas function.

⋈: High-fidelity geometry enforcement — the shower's lateral distribution (NKG function) and arrival time structure encode the primary direction with <1° uncertainty, near-certain information transmission.
The Fly's Eye measurement permanently fixes the event — 3.2×10^20 eV, direction (RA/Dec), shower profile — an append-only ROM record in the cosmic-ray database.
The atmospheric detector volume closes — the full cascade from first interaction to ground footprint is contained, the boundary encodes the bulk trajectory losslessly (holographic principle).
The observed cosmic-ray spectrum reunites both arms — the suppressed flux below GZK (F-arm) and the rare super-GZK events (T-arm) form the complete measured distribution with its anomaly.

The error-correction loop closes — the measured anomaly (OMG particle) feeds back to constrain source models, propagation physics, and fundamental symmetries, completing the cosmic error-correction cycle.

phase_5.compiler_frontend: The standard model of particle physics + general relativity + cosmology translates astrophysical source intentions into UHECR propagation operations (photopion cross-sections, magnetic deflection, redshift evolution).
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: Components communicate via the cosmic microwave background (CMB photon bath as the interaction medium), intergalactic magnetic fields (deflection channel), and the atmosphere (detector coupling via nuclear and electromagnetic cascades).
phase_5.memory_mechanism: State is stored in the proton's phase space (energy, momentum, position), the cascade's longitudinal and lateral profiles (shower memory), and the detector's recorded Cherenkov/fluorescence photons (measurement memory).
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: The interaction length (λ_int) and radiation length (X_0) determine the timing of cascade stages; the GZK mean free path (~50 Mpc at 10^20 eV) schedules the photopion interactions; the detector trigger schedules the readout.
phase_5.alfs_store: The Fly's Eye 1991 event record (energy, direction, profile) serves as the canonical bootstrap store — the reference measurement that anchors all subsequent UHECR analyses and propagation model fits.

phase_6.cycle_cost: The primary proton's free energy (3.2×10^20 eV) is consumed per cycle, dissipated as ionization, excitation, Cherenkov light, and heat in the atmosphere; the CMB photon bath provides the cold reservoir.
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: A single ultra-high-energy proton in intergalactic space with definite energy and direction; the atmosphere in ground state; detectors idle.
phase_6.post_cycle_state: A fully developed air shower with ~10^11 secondary particles; a permanent measurement record in the Fly's Eye database; an updated cosmic-ray spectrum with the super-GZK anomaly; constrained source and propagation models.
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The cycle is entropy-conservative because the proton's enormous free energy is exactly balanced by the information gain: the measurement extracts ~log2(10^11) bits of source information from the cascade, while the dissipated energy thermalizes in the atmosphere, preserving the total entropy budget. The error-correction function (recovering source properties from the shower) is a Maxwell's demon operation powered by the proton's energy.
